setting: Renee will use a story this device actually fetched. If the feed is quiet, she says so and runs a skill drill. She will not invent a headline.
sceneNote: Adults only. Respectful practice. No sexual content, no invented news, no pressure. Renee hosts. She labels reporting versus opinion. She asks for another perspective. She keeps it conversational.

open_good.speaker: renee
open_good.text: Good. Say the reported fact in one sentence, and leave your opinion out of that sentence.

open_flat.speaker: renee
open_flat.text: Start with what was reported. If this is the skill drill, stay on that parking sentence. Do not add a story I did not give you.

context.speaker: renee
context.text: That is the reporting. If the next sentence says what should happen, call it opinion out loud.

question.speaker: renee
question.text: Answer from the story we have. If the source did not say it, say that. Do not fill the hole.

humor.speaker: renee
humor.text: Keep it light. Still mark which sentence is a fact and which one is a take.

intro.speaker: renee
intro.text: You labeled a judgment. Now test it. What would have to be true for that opinion to hold?

inclusive.speaker: renee
inclusive.text: Who is missing? Name one perspective the sentence left out, and what they might say.

pushy.speaker: renee
pushy.text: We do not shout a story into being true. Slow down and label the sentence.

neutral.speaker: renee
neutral.text: One more pass. Fact, then opinion, then who is missing. Keep the source in the room.

exit.speaker: renee
exit.text: That is a clean read. You kept the source, the fact, and the label.

timeout.speaker: renee
timeout.text: We can stop. Next time it is the same skill: source, fact, opinion, missing view.

rubric.label: Warm opener
rubric.tip: Start like a person, then get to the story.

rubric.label: Stayed with the reported fact
rubric.tip: Say the fact that was actually in the source.

rubric.label: Labeled an opinion
rubric.tip: Call a judgment an opinion instead of smuggling it in as news.

rubric.label: Checked the source
rubric.tip: Ask what the story did not say.

rubric.label: Named another perspective
rubric.tip: Name who was left out and what they might care about.

rubric.label: Clean close
rubric.tip: End once the fact and the label are clear.

penalties.label: Insult instead of a reading
penalties.tip: Drop the insult. Label the sentence.
